first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: Wearing a gray broad-brimmed steel helmet and an orange-brown back protector, with a light brown cloth bag and a vertical long gun on the back; continuously walks from the center midground to the left foreground.

entities.name: Person B
entities.identification: The soldier ahead of Person A who has a square backpack, wears a brown high-collared long garment, and carries a long gun; not the soldier in the left foreground at the beginning.

entities.name: trench wall
entities.identification: The walls on both sides of the passageway, composed of brown mud walls, gray-brown horizontal planks, and vertical or inclined wooden posts, excluding the ground and the sandbags atop the walls.

entities.name: group of other soldiers in the trench
entities.identification: A group of soldiers in the background, including in this clip the person at the lower-right entrance at the beginning and the two seated soldiers on the right later.

entities.name: wood-framed bunker with a dark opening
entities.identification: A dark entrance framed by thick wooden beams within the right wall, with multiple layers of sandbags stacked above it.

entities.name: muddy passageway ground
entities.identification: The gray-brown, uneven, narrow passage surface at the bottom of the trench, with wet, shiny patches and debris in places.

entities.name: brown sandbags atop the wall
entities.identification: Brown, elongated, rounded bag-like objects stacked horizontally in layers along the tops of both walls.

entities.name: exposed mound of earth atop the wall
entities.identification: An irregularly contoured mound of exposed brown earth behind the sandbags and rising above the top of the wall.

entities.name: grayish-white sky
entities.identification: The low-saturation grayish-white sky area above the earth mounds on both sides, with gradual variations in brightness.

entities.name: trench cable
entities.identification: Thin, elongated dark lines running along the walls and strung between utility poles, recorded in groups according to visible areas.

entities.name: utility pole
entities.identification: A vertical pole-like structure protruding above the earth mound, with a crossarm at the top.

entities.name: soldier's long gun
entities.identification: An elongated gun-shaped object with a brown wooden elongated section and a dark metal section, counted at clearly distinguishable positions.

entities.name: light gray smoke
entities.identification: Light gray with a bluish cast, translucent smoke with diffuse edges near the seated soldiers on the right.
